{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Goron City}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== After [[Link]] has freed the [[Divine Beast Vah Rudania]] from [[Fireblight Ganon]], he can encounter the [[Gerudo]] merchant [[Ramella]] in [[Goron City]]. When Link speaks to her, she calls him bold for flirting with her in the middle of the day.{{Cite|Sav'aaq. Flirting in the middle of the day, are we? Bold.|Ramella|BotW}} However, Ramella is disappointed if Link refutes this.{{Cite|[That's not what I—] Oh. That's too bad.|Ramella|BotW}} Ramella explains that she is originally from the [[Region]] of [[Gerudo]], and she came to Goron City to find [[Gem]]s.{{Cite|I'm Ramella. As you can see, I'm from the Gerudo region. I came for the {{Color BotW|Blue|jewels}} that are to be found in Goron City.|Ramella|BotW}} Since Death Mountain's eruptions have now stopped, she has begun restocking on Gems.{{Cite|The eruptions on {{Color BotW|Blue|Death Mountain}} have finally come to a stop. As a result, we've started restocking {{Color BotW|Blue|jewels}}.|Ramella|BotW}} Ramella asks Link if he has any [[Amber]], as she is in need of it.{{Cite|Oh... Do you have some {{Color BotW|Red|amber}} too? I need a whole lot of it.|Ramella|BotW}} If he brings her 10, Ramella promises to pay him more compared to the usual selling price at stores.{{Cite|Bring me {{Color BotW|Red|10}} of them, and I'll buy them for more than a shop would pay!|Ramella|BotW}} This begins the [[Side Quest]]. Once Link has 10 pieces of Amber, Ramella will ask him to sell to her,{{Cite|In any case, do you have {{Color BotW|Red|10 pieces of amber}}? If so, will you sell them to me?|Ramella|BotW}} offering him 500 [[Rupee]]s as payment.{{Cite|Yes, 10 pieces of amber... Sell them to the shop, and you'll get 300 rupees. Or sell them to me for {{Color BotW|Red|500 rupees}}!|Ramella|BotW}} After Link sells to her, the Side Quest will be complete. From this point on, Ramella will offer to pay extra whenever Link brings her 10 pieces of a randomly chosen Gem.{{Cite|I need to procure other {{Color BotW|Blue|jewels}} too, so keep bringing me what you find. Bring me {{Color BotW|Red|10}} at a time, got it? As for what kinds of jewels I want to buy, well... That's likely to change {{Color BotW|Red|every once in a while}}.|Ramella|BotW}} ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | Ramella, a precious-stone wholesaler, let you know that she'll pay top rupee for gems.

Bring Ramella {{Color BotW|Red|10 pieces}} of {{Color BotW|Red|amber}} to establish a working relationship. |- | Complete | True to her word, Ramella paid well for your 10 amber chunks.

As any merchant would, Ramella is looking to maintain a steady stock of gems. She'll continue to pay well for whatever gems you bring her in the future. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Amber Dealer * Goron City * Ramella * Side Quest }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
